name: infobase_admin
description: Infobase and launch administration - list applications, create / register / delete an infobase, set credentials, create a launch configuration, start a 1C client from one, update the database, dump or load the whole infobase as a .dt file, control EDT<->infobase sync. Operations: get_applications, list_registered_infobases, read_event_log, create_infobase, register_infobase, delete_infobase, set_infobase_credentials, create_launch_config, start_client, branch_infobase, update_database, inspect_database_sync, export_database_snapshot, restore_database_snapshot, sync_control, help. Pass operation=<name>; remaining parameters follow the per-operation contracts (call operation=help for the catalog). create_infobase / register_infobase / delete_infobase / set_infobase_credentials / update_database / export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot mutate, and a load replaces everything the infobase holds, marks the stored copy, and names it when the mark could not be written; inspect_database_sync reads and changes nothing. A real run of update_database / export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot / sync_control may reply with a Pending status and a runKey to resume. update_database takes dryRun to answer what an update would face and start nothing, answered in place with no runKey, and protectData (default on) to stop before the update when it would delete data, answering dataLossTables (acceptDataLoss=true carries the deletion through). sync_control has its own inner operation (status / diagnose / suppress / ...): pass it as syncOperation, not operation - operation here always selects the infobase_admin routing target. The standalone tools remain available for back-compat.

operation.description: get_applications / list_registered_infobases / read_event_log / create_infobase / register_infobase / delete_infobase / set_infobase_credentials / create_launch_config / start_client / branch_infobase / update_database / inspect_database_sync / export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot / sync_control / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like getApplications is also accepted). operation=help lists them; topic=<operation> answers what that one takes.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help. Without topic - lists all operations with one-line summaries.

find.description: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.

dryRun.description: update_database: answer what an update would face and start nothing.

ignoreBranchBinding.description: update_database: update even when the branch is bound to another application.

ignoreDumpInfoFormat.description: update_database: update even when the stored ConfigDumpInfo.xml carries a format other than the one this infobase's Designer wrote - the answer names both formats when it stops you, and expects a FULL load when it does not.

branch.description: branch_infobase: the branch to bind or unbind. Defaults to the branch the project is on.

excludeEvents.description: read_event_log: events to leave out, by whole name or, ending in *, by the start of it - _$Transaction$_* drops the transaction events. Case is ignored; applied before limit.

name.description: Infobase name: required for create_infobase, delete_infobase and register_infobase of a server infobase. sync_control release_support_snapshot: the snapshot's file name from list_support_snapshots.

path.description: create_infobase: absolute path to the infobase directory (required for that operation) - an empty/new directory for the .1CD. register_infobase: an existing file infobase directory. export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot: the .dt file to write or to load (required for both); an existing file at that path is refused, not replaced.

backupTo.description: restore_database_snapshot: where the backup of the infobase's current contents goes before the load starts. Omitted - beside the .dt being loaded, named after it and stamped with the time. The load does not start until the backup is written; an existing file at the backup path is refused.

connectionString.description: register_infobase: a server infobase address, Srvr=<server>;Ref=<infobase>.

makeDefault.description: register_infobase: make the application the project's default (omitted: only when it has none).

platform.description: create_infobase: 1C:Enterprise platform version (optional, blank = latest available).

templateCf.description: create_infobase: optional path to a .cf / .cfe to load into the new infobase on create.

deleteContent.description: delete_infobase: also delete the .1CD directory on disk (DESTRUCTIVE, irreversible; default false = only remove the reference from EDT's list).

infobaseName.description: create_launch_config: name of an existing infobase in EDT's list to associate (required for that operation).

accessMode.description: set_infobase_credentials / register_infobase: INFOBASE (user + password) or OS (pass-through, no user/password).

userName.description: set_infobase_credentials / register_infobase: infobase user name (for INFOBASE access).

password.description: set_infobase_credentials / register_infobase: infobase password (for INFOBASE access). Stored encrypted; never logged or returned.

launchConfigurationName.description: update_database / start_client: exact name of an existing EDT runtime-client launch configuration (preferred over projectName + applicationId - see list_configurations).

updateBeforeLaunch.description: start_client: update before starting (default false). Explicit true is refused when a preset disabled update_database. A running client with no startupOption, waitForEndpoint, clientType or runMode answers alreadyRunning (started=false) before that gate.

allowSecondSession.description: start_client: start even when this configuration already has a client running (default false - the running one is reported instead).

startupOption.description: start_client: /C only, on this launch's copy; the saved configuration is not changed. An external-object binding and /Execute are set by the environment from that configuration, not by this argument. Refused while its client is already running.

clientType.description: start_client: the client to start - thin, thick or web. Omitted: the launch configuration's own, thin for one created here, and thick whenever the run mode is ordinary. Applied to this launch's own configuration copy; a configuration created here is saved with it.

runMode.description: start_client: ordinary or managed; omitted, the configuration's default run mode. Ordinary puts /RunModeOrdinaryApplication among the infobase's additional launch parameters for this EDT session, managed takes it out; the list on disk is not written. The answer says what changed.

waitForEndpoint.description: start_client: wait for this URL to answer before reporting started - ready is any final status below 500, at most five redirects. A client whose endpoint never answers is NOT stopped; the refusal says so.

endpointTimeoutSeconds.description: start_client: how long to wait for waitForEndpoint, default 20, limit 50. Refused without waitForEndpoint.

fullUpdate.description: update_database: true triggers a full reload; false runs an incremental update instead (default false).

verifyInfobaseContent.description: update_database: before an incremental update, read the infobase's own ConfigDumpInfo and refuse when it does not match the stored copy (default false).

autoRestructure.description: update_database: apply infobase restructuring automatically when required (default true).

protectData.description: update_database: before starting, compare the infobase's synchronization baseline with the model; a data-carrying entity the base holds and the model does not stops the call with status=confirmationRequired and the addresses in dataLossTables (default true).

acceptDataLoss.description: update_database: carry through the deletion protectData found, so the update runs and the table is dropped (default false - the call is refused instead).

autoFreeClients.description: update_database: before updating, stop this project's own matching runtime-client sessions so they cannot keep the infobase locked (default false).

timeoutSeconds.description: update_database: soft wait in seconds (5-120, default 30) before Pending and a runKey. export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot: the same wait (alias waitSeconds); a large dump or load outlives it and is collected with the runKey. sync_control rebuild_dump_info: each Designer run (60-3600, default 600). retrieve_database_changes: wait before Pending (30-3600, default 300). That budget also bounds BuildTaskHelper.waitForBuildAndDerivedData; the build-job wait is unbounded and running out ends quietly. The platform pull is not cancelled.

runKey.description: update_database / export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot: resumes a Pending run issued earlier with this runKey; other params are ignored once runKey is supplied. sync_control syncOperation=retrieve_database_changes: resumes that Pending pull; how long this call waits is timeoutSeconds.

cancel.description: update_database / export_database_snapshot / restore_database_snapshot: combined with runKey, detach and stop tracking that run (best-effort only; a load that has begun is not undone). sync_control syncOperation=retrieve_database_changes: with runKey, stop tracking that pull. The platform call, once started, is still running and the answer says so.

statusOnly.description: update_database: read what updates are being tracked and start nothing - runKeys, state, elapsed time. projectName filters by project; any other run-shaping parameter beside runKey or cancel is refused. A snapshot run is not in this list; poll it with its own runKey.

refreshWorkspace.description: update_database: refresh the project (and an extension's parent) from disk before the update state is read (default true); the answer carries workspaceRefresh.changedResources.

syncOperation.description: sync_control's OWN action - status / diagnose / diagnose_delta / suppress / reseed_baseline / mark_synchronized / diagnose_stuck_locks / recover_stuck_merge / list_support_snapshots / release_support_snapshot / rebuild_dump_info / retrieve_database_changes (required when operation=sync_control).

replaceLocal.description: sync_control syncOperation=retrieve_database_changes: false (default) refuses the pull when the project has changes of its own; true takes the infobase's version of those objects.

markSynchronized.description: sync_control syncOperation=retrieve_database_changes: true rewrites the baseline after a successful pull. A failed rewrite is baselineMarked=false with the reason on the answer. Default false.

enabled.description: sync_control syncOperation=suppress: true = suppress synchronization for the project (skip it on update), false = re-enable.

infobaseUuid.description: sync_control syncOperation=reseed_baseline / mark_synchronized / recover_stuck_merge: the target infobase (an infobaseUuid from syncOperation=status / diagnose_stuck_locks).

confirm.description: sync_control: reseed_baseline, mark_synchronized, recover_stuck_merge, rebuild_dump_info - must be true.
